```{r helpers, include=FALSE}
reverse_complement_dna <- function(seq) {
  seq <- normalize_filter_sequence(seq)
  vapply(strsplit(seq, "", fixed = TRUE), function(chars) {
    paste(rev(chartr("ACGTN", "TGCAN", chars)), collapse = "")
  }, character(1))
}

read_fasta_sequence_table <- function(file_path, reference_set) {
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    return(tibble(ReferenceSet = character(), ReferenceFile = character(), ReferenceHeader = character(), ReferenceSequence = character()))
  }
  lines <- readLines(file_path, warn = FALSE)
  lines <- trimws(lines)
  lines <- lines[nzchar(lines)]
  if (length(lines) == 0) {
    return(tibble(ReferenceSet = character(), ReferenceFile = character(), ReferenceHeader = character(), ReferenceSequence = character()))
  }
  record_index <- cumsum(startsWith(lines, ">"))
  tibble(Line = lines, IsHeader = startsWith(lines, ">"), RecordIndex = record_index) %>%
    group_by(RecordIndex) %>%
    summarise(
      ReferenceHeader = sub("^>", "", first(Line[IsHeader])),
      ReferenceSequence = paste(Line[!IsHeader], collapse = ""),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      ReferenceSet = reference_set,
      ReferenceFile = file_path,
      ReferenceHeader,
      ReferenceSequence = normalize_filter_sequence(ReferenceSequence)
    )
}

read_tsv_lower <- function(file_path) {
  out <- read_tsv_flex(file_path)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(tibble())
  out %>% rename_with(tolower)
}

collect_endosirna_sample_files <- function(pattern) {
  if (!dir.exists(SPORTS_ENDOSIRNA_DIR)) return(character())
  list.files(
    file.path(SPORTS_ENDOSIRNA_DIR, "samples"),
    pattern = pattern,
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
}

read_endosirna_count_files <- function(pattern, required_cols) {
  files <- collect_endosirna_sample_files(pattern)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(tibble())
  purrr::map_dfr(files, function(file_path) {
    df <- read_tsv_lower(file_path)
    if (nrow(df) == 0 || !all(required_cols %in% names(df))) return(tibble())
    df %>% mutate(source_file = file_path)
  })
}

two_group_shift <- function(df, value_col, feature_cols = "ReferenceSet") {
  if (nrow(df) == 0 || length(group_levels) != 2 || !all(c("Group", value_col, feature_cols) %in% names(df))) return(tibble())
  base_group <- group_levels[[1]]
  case_group <- group_levels[[2]]
  mean_or_na <- function(x) {
    x <- x[is.finite(x)]
    if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Group = as.character(Group),
      Value = clean_numeric(.data[[value_col]])
    )
  df2 %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(feature_cols))) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      baseline_mean <- mean_or_na(.x$Value[.x$Group == base_group])
      case_mean <- mean_or_na(.x$Value[.x$Group == case_group])
      tibble(
        BaselineMean = baseline_mean,
        CaseMean = case_mean,
        Log2CaseOverBaseline = if (is.na(baseline_mean) || is.na(case_mean)) NA_real_ else log2((case_mean + 1e-9) / (baseline_mean + 1e-9)),
        PValue = calculate_two_group_pvalue(.x, value_col = "Value", group_col = "Group", group_levels = group_levels)
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      FDR = p.adjust(PValue, method = "BH"),
      Comparison = paste(case_group, "vs", base_group)
    )
}

plot_group_box <- function(df, value_col, title_text, y_label, section, file_name, facet_col = "ReferenceSet", percent = FALSE) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    save_plot_nested(plot_note(title_text, "No data available."), section, file_name, width = 8.5, height = 5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels),
      Value = clean_numeric(.data[[value_col]])
    )
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Group, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.58, alpha = 0.72, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Group), position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0), size = 2.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  if (facet_col %in% names(plot_df)) {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(stats::as.formula(paste("~", facet_col)), scales = "free_y")
  }
  if (isTRUE(percent)) {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.01), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))
  }
  save_plot_nested(p, section, file_name, width = 10.5, height = 6.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
  invisible(p)
}

plot_reclassified_sports_length <- function(sample_id, df, category_levels_local, category_palette_local) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id, RPM > 0) %>%
    mutate(Category = factor(as.character(Category), levels = category_levels_local))
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    return(plot_note(paste(sample_id, "endo-siRNA reclassified sncRNA distribution"), "No sequence-level data available."))
  }
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9, color = "white", linewidth = 0.05) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = category_palette_local, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(plot_df$Length, na.rm = TRUE), max(plot_df$Length, na.rm = TRUE), by = 5), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
    labs(
      x = "Length",
      y = "RPM",
      title = paste(sample_id, "sncRNA length distribution after endo-siRNA replacement")
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
}

plot_reclassified_sports_composition <- function(sample_id, df, category_levels_local, category_palette_local) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id, Reads > 0) %>%
    mutate(Category = factor(as.character(Category), levels = category_levels_local))
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    return(plot_note(paste(sample_id, "endo-siRNA reclassified composition"), "No sequence-level data available."))
  }
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Category, y = Percent, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Percent >= 0.25, sprintf("%.1f", Percent), "")), vjust = -0.25, size = 3.0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = category_palette_local, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Percent of clean reads",
      title = paste(sample_id, "sncRNA composition after endo-siRNA replacement")
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r reference-manifest, include=FALSE}
  UseInExactProxy=tolower(as.character(UseInExactProxy)) %in% c("true","1"), ApproxRecords=NA_integer_, FileExists=file.exists(ReferenceFile))
if (any(!endo_reference_manifest$FileExists)) stop("MISSING explicit endo reference FASTA")
write_csv_safe(endo_reference_manifest, "02_reference_manifest/endo_siRNA_reference_manifest.csv")
```

```{r exact-reference-proxy, include=FALSE}
active_endo_references <- endo_reference_manifest %>% filter(UseInExactProxy, FileExists)

if (nrow(active_endo_references) == 0) {
  endo_reference_status <- tibble(status = "skipped", message = "No configured exact-reference FASTA files were found.")
  write_csv_safe(endo_reference_status, "03_exact_reference_proxy/01_summary/endo_siRNA_reference_status.csv")
  save_plot_nested(plot_note("endo-siRNA exact proxy", "No configured exact-reference FASTA files were found."), "03_exact_reference_proxy/01_summary", "endo_siRNA_reference_proxy_note.pdf", width = 8.5, height = 5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
} else {
  endo_reference_tbl <- purrr::map2_dfr(active_endo_references$ReferenceFile, active_endo_references$ReferenceSet, read_fasta_sequence_table) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ReferenceSequence), ReferenceSequence != "") %>%
    mutate(ReferenceLength = nchar(ReferenceSequence)) %>%
    filter(ReferenceLength >= 18, ReferenceLength <= 32) %>%
    group_by(ReferenceSet, ReferenceSequence) %>%
    summarise(
      ReferenceRecordN = n(),
      ReferenceHeader = paste(head(unique(ReferenceHeader), 5), collapse = ";"),
      ReferenceLength = first(ReferenceLength),
      ReferenceFile = first(ReferenceFile),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  endo_reference_summary <- endo_reference_tbl %>%
    group_by(ReferenceSet, ReferenceFile) %>%
    summarise(
      ReferenceSequences = n(),
      ReferenceRecords = sum(ReferenceRecordN, na.rm = TRUE),
      MinLength = min(ReferenceLength, na.rm = TRUE),
      MaxLength = max(ReferenceLength, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  write_csv_safe(endo_reference_summary, "03_exact_reference_proxy/01_summary/endo_siRNA_reference_summary.csv")

  if (pkg_has("data.table")) {
    output_dt <- data.table::as.data.table(output_all)
    output_dt <- data.table::copy(output_dt)
    output_dt[, Sample := as.character(Sample)]
    output_dt[, Group := as.character(Group)]
    output_dt[, SequenceNorm := normalize_filter_sequence(Sequence)]
    output_dt[, Length := clean_numeric(Length)]
    output_dt[, Reads := clean_numeric(Reads)]
    output_dt[, RPM := clean_numeric(RPM)]
    output_dt[, PrimaryAnnotation := ifelse(is.na(PrimaryAnnotation) | PrimaryAnnotation == "", "NO_Annotation", as.character(PrimaryAnnotation))]
    output_dt[, FeatureCategory := ifelse(is.na(FeatureCategory) | FeatureCategory == "", "other", as.character(FeatureCategory))]
    output_dt <- output_dt[!is.na(SequenceNorm) & SequenceNorm != "" & Length >= 18 & Length <= 32 & is.finite(Reads) & Reads > 0]
    if (nrow(output_dt) == 0) {
      output_sequence_for_endo <- tibble(
        Sample = character(), Group = character(), SequenceNorm = character(), ReverseComplement = character(),
        Length = numeric(), Reads = numeric(), RPM = numeric(), CurrentAnnotation = character(), CurrentCategory = character()
      )
    } else {
      seq_rc_dt <- unique(output_dt[, .(SequenceNorm)])
      seq_rc_dt[, ReverseComplement := reverse_complement_dna(SequenceNorm)]
      output_dt <- seq_rc_dt[output_dt, on = "SequenceNorm"]
      read_dt <- output_dt[, .(
        Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
        RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE)
      ), by = .(Sample, Group, SequenceNorm, ReverseComplement, Length)]
      ann_dt <- output_dt[, .(
        AnnotationReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE)
      ), by = .(Sample, Group, SequenceNorm, Length, PrimaryAnnotation, FeatureCategory)]
      data.table::setorder(ann_dt, Sample, Group, SequenceNorm, Length, -AnnotationReads, PrimaryAnnotation, FeatureCategory)
      ann_top_dt <- ann_dt[, .(
        CurrentAnnotation = PrimaryAnnotation[1L],
        CurrentCategory = FeatureCategory[1L]
      ), by = .(Sample, Group, SequenceNorm, Length)]
      output_sequence_for_endo <- merge(
        read_dt,
        ann_top_dt,
        by = c("Sample", "Group", "SequenceNorm", "Length"),
        all.x = TRUE,
        sort = FALSE
      ) %>%
        as_tibble()
    }
  } else {
    output_sequence_for_endo <- output_all %>%
      filter(!is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "") %>%
      mutate(
        SequenceNorm = normalize_filter_sequence(Sequence),
        ReverseComplement = reverse_complement_dna(SequenceNorm),
        Length = clean_numeric(Length)
      ) %>%
      filter(Length >= 18, Length <= 32) %>%
      group_by(Sample, Group, SequenceNorm, ReverseComplement, Length) %>%
      summarise(
        Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
        RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
        CurrentAnnotation = {
          ann_counts <- sort(table(PrimaryAnnotation), decreasing = TRUE)
          if (length(ann_counts) == 0) "NO_Annotation" else names(ann_counts)[[1]]
        },
        CurrentCategory = {
          cat_counts <- sort(table(FeatureCategory), decreasing = TRUE)
          if (length(cat_counts) == 0) "other" else names(cat_counts)[[1]]
        },
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }

  if (pkg_has("data.table")) {
    output_dt <- data.table::as.data.table(output_sequence_for_endo)
    reference_dt <- data.table::as.data.table(endo_reference_tbl)
    reference_sequence_set <- unique(reference_dt$ReferenceSequence)
    same_candidates_dt <- output_dt[SequenceNorm %chin% reference_sequence_set]
    rc_candidates_dt <- output_dt[ReverseComplement %chin% reference_sequence_set]
    same_dt <- merge(
      same_candidates_dt,
      reference_dt,
      by.x = "SequenceNorm",
      by.y = "ReferenceSequence",
      all = FALSE,
      sort = FALSE,
      allow.cartesian = TRUE
    )
    same_dt[, MatchOrientation := "same"]
    rc_dt <- merge(
      rc_candidates_dt,
      reference_dt,
      by.x = "ReverseComplement",
      by.y = "ReferenceSequence",
      all = FALSE,
      sort = FALSE,
      allow.cartesian = TRUE
    )
    rc_dt[, MatchOrientation := "reverse_complement"]
    hits_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(list(same_dt, rc_dt), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
    if (nrow(hits_dt) > 0) {
      data.table::setorder(hits_dt, Sample, -Reads, ReferenceSet, SequenceNorm, MatchOrientation)
      hits_dt <- unique(hits_dt, by = c("Sample", "SequenceNorm", "ReferenceSet", "MatchOrientation"))
    }
    endo_reference_hits <- as_tibble(hits_dt)
  } else {
    reference_sequence_set <- unique(endo_reference_tbl$ReferenceSequence)
    endo_reference_hits <- bind_rows(
      output_sequence_for_endo %>%
        filter(SequenceNorm %in% reference_sequence_set) %>%
        inner_join(endo_reference_tbl, by = c("SequenceNorm" = "ReferenceSequence")) %>%
        mutate(MatchOrientation = "same"),
      output_sequence_for_endo %>%
        filter(ReverseComplement %in% reference_sequence_set) %>%
        inner_join(endo_reference_tbl, by = c("ReverseComplement" = "ReferenceSequence")) %>%
        mutate(MatchOrientation = "reverse_complement")
    ) %>%
      arrange(Sample, desc(Reads), ReferenceSet, SequenceNorm, MatchOrientation) %>%
      distinct(Sample, SequenceNorm, ReferenceSet, MatchOrientation, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  endo_reference_hits_dedup <- endo_reference_hits %>%
    arrange(Sample, SequenceNorm, ReferenceSet, desc(Reads), MatchOrientation) %>%
    distinct(Sample, SequenceNorm, ReferenceSet, .keep_all = TRUE)

  endo_by_sample <- endo_reference_hits_dedup %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, ReferenceSet) %>%
    summarise(MatchedReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), MatchedRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), MatchedSequences = n_distinct(SequenceNorm), .groups = "drop") %>%
    right_join(
      tidyr::crossing(sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)), endo_reference_summary %>% select(ReferenceSet)),
      by = c("Sample", "Group", "ReferenceSet")
    ) %>%
    left_join(clean_reads_tbl %>% mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample)), by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(
      MatchedReads = replace_na(MatchedReads, 0),
      MatchedRPM = replace_na(MatchedRPM, 0),
      MatchedSequences = replace_na(MatchedSequences, 0),
      CleanReads = replace_na(CleanReads, 0),
      MatchedReadFraction = if_else(CleanReads > 0, MatchedReads / CleanReads, 0),
      DicerSizedReadFraction = NA_real_
    ) %>%
    arrange(ReferenceSet, Group, Sample)

  exact_length_signature <- endo_reference_hits_dedup %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, ReferenceSet, Length) %>%
    summarise(MatchedReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), MatchedRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, ReferenceSet) %>%
    mutate(
      TotalMatchedReads = sum(MatchedReads, na.rm = TRUE),
      LengthFraction = if_else(TotalMatchedReads > 0, MatchedReads / TotalMatchedReads, 0),
      LengthClass = case_when(
        Length >= 21 & Length <= 24 ~ "Dicer-sized_21_24",
        Length >= 26 & Length <= 31 ~ "piRNA-like_26_31",
        TRUE ~ "other_18_32"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  exact_length_class_by_sample <- exact_length_signature %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, ReferenceSet, LengthClass) %>%
    summarise(MatchedReads = sum(MatchedReads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, ReferenceSet) %>%
    mutate(
      TotalMatchedReads = sum(MatchedReads, na.rm = TRUE),
      LengthClassFraction = if_else(TotalMatchedReads > 0, MatchedReads / TotalMatchedReads, 0)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  exact_top_sequences <- endo_reference_hits_dedup %>%
    mutate(
      InterpretationClass = case_when(
        CurrentAnnotation == "NO_Annotation" | CurrentCategory == "other" ~ "unannotated_or_other_candidate",
        CurrentCategory %in% c("piRNA", "lncRNA") ~ "overlap_regulatory_sncRNA",
        TRUE ~ paste0("overlap_", CurrentCategory)
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(ReferenceSet, SequenceNorm, Length, CurrentAnnotation, CurrentCategory, InterpretationClass) %>%
    summarise(
      TotalReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
      TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
      SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
      GroupsDetected = paste(sort(unique(Group)), collapse = ";"),
      MatchOrientations = paste(sort(unique(MatchOrientation)), collapse = ";"),
      ExampleReferenceHeader = paste(head(unique(ReferenceHeader), 3), collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(TotalReads), desc(SampleN), ReferenceSet) %>%
    slice_head(n = 500)

  exact_conservative_candidates <- endo_reference_hits_dedup %>%
    mutate(
      InterpretationClass = case_when(
        CurrentAnnotation == "NO_Annotation" | CurrentCategory == "other" ~ "unannotated_or_other_candidate",
        CurrentCategory %in% c("piRNA", "lncRNA") ~ "overlap_regulatory_sncRNA",
        TRUE ~ paste0("overlap_", CurrentCategory)
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(InterpretationClass == "unannotated_or_other_candidate")

  exact_shift <- two_group_shift(endo_by_sample, "MatchedReadFraction")

  write_csv_safe(endo_reference_hits, "03_exact_reference_proxy/02_sequence_hits/endo_siRNA_exact_hits_all.csv")
  write_csv_safe(endo_reference_hits_dedup, "03_exact_reference_proxy/02_sequence_hits/endo_siRNA_exact_hits_deduplicated.csv")
  write_csv_safe(endo_by_sample, "03_exact_reference_proxy/01_summary/endo_siRNA_exact_by_sample.csv")
  write_csv_safe(two_group_shift(endo_by_sample, "MatchedReadFraction"), "05_group_shift/endo_siRNA_exact_fraction_group_shift.csv")
  write_csv_safe(exact_length_signature, "03_exact_reference_proxy/03_length_signature/endo_siRNA_exact_length_signature.csv")
  write_csv_safe(exact_length_class_by_sample, "03_exact_reference_proxy/03_length_signature/endo_siRNA_exact_length_class_by_sample.csv")
  write_csv_safe(exact_top_sequences, "03_exact_reference_proxy/02_sequence_hits/endo_siRNA_exact_top_sequences.csv")
  write_csv_safe(exact_conservative_candidates, "03_exact_reference_proxy/04_conservative_candidates/endo_siRNA_exact_conservative_candidate_hits.csv")

  plot_group_box(endo_by_sample, "MatchedReadFraction", "Exact-reference endo-siRNA fraction", "Fraction of clean reads", "03_exact_reference_proxy/01_summary", "endo_siRNA_exact_fraction_by_group.pdf", percent = TRUE)

  if (nrow(exact_length_signature) > 0) {
    p_exact_len <- exact_length_signature %>%
      transmute(Sample, Group, ReferenceSet, Length, Reads = MatchedReads, RPM = MatchedRPM) %>%
      summarise_group_mean_rpm(c("ReferenceSet", "Length")) %>%
      mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = Length, y = RPM, color = Group, group = Group)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
      facet_wrap(~ ReferenceSet, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = "Exact-reference endo-siRNA length signature", x = "Length", y = "Mean RPM", color = "Group") +
      mii_theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "top")
    save_plot_nested(p_exact_len, "03_exact_reference_proxy/03_length_signature", "endo_siRNA_exact_length_signature.pdf", width = 10.5, height = 6.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
  }
}
```

```{r bowtie-evidence, include=FALSE}
bowtie_summary_file <- sports_endosirna_summary_file()
bowtie_required_cols <- c("sample", "ref_tag", "total_reads", "mapped_reads", "mapped_fraction", "total_alignments")

if (!file.exists(bowtie_summary_file) || file.size(bowtie_summary_file) == 0) {
  bowtie_status <- tibble(status = "skipped", message = paste0("RUN_ENDOSIRNA summary not found: ", bowtie_summary_file))
  write_csv_safe(bowtie_status, "04_bowtie_evidence/01_summary/endo_siRNA_bowtie_status.csv")
  save_plot_nested(plot_note("Bowtie endo-siRNA evidence", "RUN_ENDOSIRNA summary was not found."), "04_bowtie_evidence/01_summary", "endo_siRNA_bowtie_note.pdf", width = 8.5, height = 5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
} else {
  bowtie_raw <- read_tsv_lower(bowtie_summary_file)
  if (!all(bowtie_required_cols %in% names(bowtie_raw))) {
    bowtie_status <- tibble(status = "skipped", message = paste0("Summary lacks required columns: ", paste(setdiff(bowtie_required_cols, names(bowtie_raw)), collapse = ", ")))
    write_csv_safe(bowtie_status, "04_bowtie_evidence/01_summary/endo_siRNA_bowtie_status.csv")
  } else {
    for (optional_col in c("unique_mapped_sequences", "unique_reference_ids", "modal_length", "bowtie_output", "bowtie_log")) {
      if (!optional_col %in% names(bowtie_raw)) bowtie_raw[[optional_col]] <- NA
    }
    bowtie_by_sample <- bowtie_raw %>%
      transmute(
        Sample = as.character(sample),
        ReferenceSet = as.character(ref_tag),
        TotalReads = clean_numeric(total_reads),
        MappedReads = clean_numeric(mapped_reads),
        MappedFraction = clean_numeric(mapped_fraction),
        TotalAlignments = clean_numeric(total_alignments),
        UniqueMappedSequences = clean_numeric(unique_mapped_sequences),
        UniqueReferenceIds = clean_numeric(unique_reference_ids),
        ModalLength = as.character(modal_length),
        BowtieOutput = as.character(bowtie_output),
        BowtieLog = as.character(bowtie_log)
      ) %>%
      left_join(sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)), by = "Sample") %>%
      mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

    sequence_counts_raw <- read_endosirna_count_files("[.]sequence_counts[.]tsv$", c("sample", "ref_tag", "sequence", "length", "mapped_reads", "total_alignments"))
    sequence_counts <- if (nrow(sequence_counts_raw) == 0) {
      tibble(Sample = character(), ReferenceSet = character(), Sequence = character(), Length = numeric(), MappedReads = numeric(), TotalAlignments = numeric(), Group = character())
    } else {
      sequence_counts_raw %>%
        transmute(
          Sample = as.character(sample),
          ReferenceSet = as.character(ref_tag),
          Sequence = normalize_filter_sequence(sequence),
          Length = clean_numeric(length),
          MappedReads = clean_numeric(mapped_reads),
          TotalAlignments = clean_numeric(total_alignments)
        ) %>%
        left_join(sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)), by = "Sample")
    }

    reference_counts_raw <- read_endosirna_count_files("[.]reference_counts[.]tsv$", c("sample", "ref_tag", "reference_id", "mapped_reads", "total_alignments"))
    reference_counts <- if (nrow(reference_counts_raw) == 0) {
      tibble(Sample = character(), ReferenceSet = character(), ReferenceId = character(), MappedReads = numeric(), TotalAlignments = numeric(), Group = character())
    } else {
      reference_counts_raw %>%
        transmute(
          Sample = as.character(sample),
          ReferenceSet = as.character(ref_tag),
          ReferenceId = as.character(reference_id),
          MappedReads = clean_numeric(mapped_reads),
          TotalAlignments = clean_numeric(total_alignments)
        ) %>%
        left_join(sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)), by = "Sample")
    }

    bowtie_length_by_sample <- sequence_counts %>%
      group_by(Sample, Group, ReferenceSet, Length) %>%
      summarise(MappedReads = sum(MappedReads, na.rm = TRUE), TotalAlignments = sum(TotalAlignments, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(Sample, Group, ReferenceSet) %>%
      mutate(
        TotalMappedReadsFromSequences = sum(MappedReads, na.rm = TRUE),
        LengthFraction = if_else(TotalMappedReadsFromSequences > 0, MappedReads / TotalMappedReadsFromSequences, 0),
        LengthClass = case_when(
          Length >= 21 & Length <= 24 ~ "Dicer-sized_21_24",
          Length >= 26 & Length <= 31 ~ "piRNA-like_26_31",
          TRUE ~ "other"
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup()

    bowtie_length_class_by_sample <- bowtie_length_by_sample %>%
      group_by(Sample, Group, ReferenceSet, LengthClass) %>%
      summarise(MappedReads = sum(MappedReads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(Sample, Group, ReferenceSet) %>%
      mutate(
        TotalMappedReadsFromSequences = sum(MappedReads, na.rm = TRUE),
        LengthClassFraction = if_else(TotalMappedReadsFromSequences > 0, MappedReads / TotalMappedReadsFromSequences, 0)
      ) %>%
      ungroup()

    bowtie_by_sample_aug <- bowtie_by_sample %>%
      left_join(
        bowtie_length_class_by_sample %>%
          filter(LengthClass == "Dicer-sized_21_24") %>%
          transmute(Sample, ReferenceSet, DicerSizedReads = MappedReads, DicerSizedFractionOfMapped = LengthClassFraction),
        by = c("Sample", "ReferenceSet")
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        bowtie_length_class_by_sample %>%
          filter(LengthClass == "piRNA-like_26_31") %>%
          transmute(Sample, ReferenceSet, PiLikeReads = MappedReads, PiLikeFractionOfMapped = LengthClassFraction),
        by = c("Sample", "ReferenceSet")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        DicerSizedReads = replace_na(DicerSizedReads, 0),
        DicerSizedFractionOfMapped = replace_na(DicerSizedFractionOfMapped, 0),
        PiLikeReads = replace_na(PiLikeReads, 0),
        PiLikeFractionOfMapped = replace_na(PiLikeFractionOfMapped, 0)
      )

    bowtie_by_group <- bowtie_by_sample_aug %>%
      group_by(Group, ReferenceSet) %>%
      summarise(
        SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
        TotalReads = sum(TotalReads, na.rm = TRUE),
        MappedReads = sum(MappedReads, na.rm = TRUE),
        MappedFraction = if_else(TotalReads > 0, MappedReads / TotalReads, 0),
        MeanSampleMappedFraction = mean(MappedFraction, na.rm = TRUE),
        MeanDicerSizedFractionOfMapped = mean(DicerSizedFractionOfMapped, na.rm = TRUE),
        MeanPiLikeFractionOfMapped = mean(PiLikeFractionOfMapped, na.rm = TRUE),
        TotalAlignments = sum(TotalAlignments, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    bowtie_shift <- bind_rows(
      two_group_shift(bowtie_by_sample_aug, "MappedFraction") %>% mutate(Metric = "MappedFraction"),
      two_group_shift(bowtie_by_sample_aug, "DicerSizedFractionOfMapped") %>% mutate(Metric = "DicerSizedFractionOfMapped"),
      two_group_shift(bowtie_by_sample_aug, "PiLikeFractionOfMapped") %>% mutate(Metric = "PiLikeFractionOfMapped")
    )

    top_bowtie_sequences <- sequence_counts %>%
      group_by(ReferenceSet, Sequence, Length) %>%
      summarise(
        TotalMappedReads = sum(MappedReads, na.rm = TRUE),
        TotalAlignments = sum(TotalAlignments, na.rm = TRUE),
        SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
        GroupsDetected = paste(sort(unique(Group)), collapse = ";"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(TotalMappedReads), desc(SampleN), ReferenceSet) %>%
      slice_head(n = 500)

    top_reference_targets <- reference_counts %>%
      group_by(ReferenceSet, ReferenceId) %>%
      summarise(
        TotalMappedReads = sum(MappedReads, na.rm = TRUE),
        TotalAlignments = sum(TotalAlignments, na.rm = TRUE),
        SampleN = n_distinct(Sample),
        GroupsDetected = paste(sort(unique(Group)), collapse = ";"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(TotalMappedReads), desc(SampleN), ReferenceSet) %>%
      slice_head(n = 500)

    write_csv_safe(tibble(status = "completed", message = bowtie_summary_file), "04_bowtie_evidence/01_summary/endo_siRNA_bowtie_status.csv")
    write_csv_safe(bowtie_by_sample_aug, "04_bowtie_evidence/01_summary/endo_siRNA_bowtie_by_sample.csv")
    write_csv_safe(bowtie_by_group, "04_bowtie_evidence/01_summary/endo_siRNA_bowtie_by_group.csv")
    write_csv_safe(bowtie_shift, "05_group_shift/endo_siRNA_bowtie_group_shift.csv")
    write_csv_safe(bowtie_length_by_sample, "04_bowtie_evidence/02_length_signature/endo_siRNA_bowtie_length_by_sample.csv")
    write_csv_safe(bowtie_length_class_by_sample, "04_bowtie_evidence/02_length_signature/endo_siRNA_bowtie_length_class_by_sample.csv")
    write_csv_safe(top_reference_targets, "04_bowtie_evidence/03_reference_targets/endo_siRNA_bowtie_top_reference_targets.csv")
    write_csv_safe(top_bowtie_sequences, "04_bowtie_evidence/04_sequence_candidates/endo_siRNA_bowtie_top_sequences.csv")

    plot_group_box(bowtie_by_sample_aug, "MappedFraction", "Bowtie endo-siRNA mapped fraction", "Mapped fraction", "04_bowtie_evidence/01_summary", "endo_siRNA_bowtie_mapped_fraction_by_group.pdf", percent = TRUE)
    plot_group_box(bowtie_by_sample_aug, "DicerSizedFractionOfMapped", "Dicer-sized fraction among Bowtie endo-siRNA reads", "21-24 nt fraction of mapped reads", "04_bowtie_evidence/02_length_signature", "endo_siRNA_bowtie_dicer_sized_fraction_by_group.pdf", percent = TRUE)

    if (nrow(bowtie_length_by_sample) > 0) {
      p_bowtie_len <- bowtie_length_by_sample %>%
        group_by(ReferenceSet, Group, Length) %>%
        summarise(MeanLengthFraction = mean(LengthFraction, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
        mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels)) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = Length, y = MeanLengthFraction, color = Group, group = Group)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
        facet_wrap(~ ReferenceSet, scales = "free_y") +
        scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
        labs(title = "Bowtie endo-siRNA length signature", x = "Length", y = "Mean fraction of mapped reads", color = "Group") +
        mii_theme_bw() +
        theme(legend.position = "top")
      save_plot_nested(p_bowtie_len, "04_bowtie_evidence/02_length_signature", "endo_siRNA_bowtie_length_signature.pdf", width = 10.5, height = 6.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
    }

    if (nrow(top_bowtie_sequences) > 0) {
      p_top_seq <- top_bowtie_sequences %>%
        arrange(desc(TotalMappedReads), Sequence) %>%
        slice_head(n = 25) %>%
        mutate(Sequence = factor(Sequence, levels = rev(unique(Sequence)))) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = Sequence, y = TotalMappedReads, fill = ReferenceSet)) +
        geom_col(width = 0.72) +
        coord_flip() +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
        labs(title = "Top Bowtie endo-siRNA candidate sequences", x = NULL, y = "Mapped reads", fill = "Reference") +
        mii_theme_bw() +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom")
      save_plot_nested(p_top_seq, "04_bowtie_evidence/04_sequence_candidates", "endo_siRNA_bowtie_top_sequences.pdf", width = 11, height = 7.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r reclassified-sports-sncRNA-distribution, include=FALSE}
reclassified_sports_levels <- c("endo-siRNA", sports_length_categories)
reclassified_sports_palette <- c("endo-siRNA" = "#7B61A8", sports_length_palette)
reclassified_sports_palette <- reclassified_sports_palette[!duplicated(names(reclassified_sports_palette))]

exact_reclass_evidence <- if (exists("endo_reference_hits_dedup") && nrow(endo_reference_hits_dedup) > 0) {
  endo_reference_hits_dedup %>%
    transmute(
      Sample = as.character(Sample),
      SequenceNorm = normalize_filter_sequence(SequenceNorm),
      EvidenceSource = "exact_reference",
      ReferenceSet = as.character(ReferenceSet)
    )
} else {
  tibble(Sample = character(), SequenceNorm = character(), EvidenceSource = character(), ReferenceSet = character())
}

bowtie_reclass_evidence <- if (exists("sequence_counts") && nrow(sequence_counts) > 0) {
  sequence_counts %>%
    filter(MappedReads > 0) %>%
    transmute(
      Sample = as.character(Sample),
      SequenceNorm = normalize_filter_sequence(Sequence),
      EvidenceSource = "bowtie",
      ReferenceSet = as.character(ReferenceSet)
    )
} else {
  tibble(Sample = character(), SequenceNorm = character(), EvidenceSource = character(), ReferenceSet = character())
}

endo_reclass_evidence <- bind_rows(exact_reclass_evidence, bowtie_reclass_evidence) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sample), Sample != "", !is.na(SequenceNorm), SequenceNorm != "") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Sample, SequenceNorm) %>%
  summarise(
    EvidenceSources = paste(sort(unique(EvidenceSource)), collapse = ";"),
    ReferenceSets = paste(sort(unique(ReferenceSet)), collapse = ";"),
    EvidenceRecordN = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

output_reclass_base <- output_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "") %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    SequenceNorm = normalize_filter_sequence(Sequence),
    Length = clean_numeric(Length),
    Length = if_else(is.finite(Length) & Length > 0, Length, as.numeric(nchar(SequenceNorm))),
    Reads = clean_numeric(Reads),
    RPM = clean_numeric(RPM),
    OriginalCategory = as.character(FeatureCategory),
    OriginalCategory = if_else(OriginalCategory %in% reclassified_sports_levels, OriginalCategory, "other"),
    OriginalAnnotation = as.character(PrimaryAnnotation)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(Length), Length > 0, is.finite(Reads), Reads > 0)

output_reclassified <- output_reclass_base %>%
  left_join(endo_reclass_evidence, by = c("Sample", "SequenceNorm")) %>%
  mutate(
    IsEndoSiRNAEvidence = !is.na(EvidenceSources),
    Category = if_else(IsEndoSiRNAEvidence, "endo-siRNA", OriginalCategory),
    Category = if_else(Category %in% reclassified_sports_levels, Category, "other")
  )

endo_reclass_status <- tibble(
  item = c("exact_reference_sequences", "bowtie_sequences", "sample_sequence_evidence", "reclassified_output_rows"),
  value = c(
    nrow(exact_reclass_evidence),
    nrow(bowtie_reclass_evidence),
    nrow(endo_reclass_evidence),
    sum(output_reclassified$IsEndoSiRNAEvidence, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  interpretation = c(
    "Sample-sequence exact overlaps with selected local endo-siRNA references.",
    "Sample-sequence Bowtie evidence from upstream RUN_ENDOSIRNA=1 output.",
    "Unique sample and sequence pairs used for replacement.",
    "SPORTS sequence-level rows reclassified to endo-siRNA in this display layer."
  )
)

reclassified_sports_length_by_sample <- output_reclassified %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Category, Length) %>%
  summarise(
    Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    EndoEvidenceReads = sum(if_else(IsEndoSiRNAEvidence, Reads, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(as.character(Category), levels = reclassified_sports_levels)) %>%
  arrange(Sample, Category, Length)

reclassified_sports_composition_by_sample <- output_reclassified %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Category) %>%
  summarise(
    Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    EndoEvidenceReads = sum(if_else(IsEndoSiRNAEvidence, Reads, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl %>% mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample)), by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    CleanReads = replace_na(CleanReads, 0),
    Percent = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 100 * Reads / CleanReads, 0),
    Category = factor(as.character(Category), levels = reclassified_sports_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample, Category)

endo_replacement_audit <- output_reclassified %>%
  filter(IsEndoSiRNAEvidence) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, OriginalCategory, Category, EvidenceSources) %>%
  summarise(
    ReclassifiedReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    ReclassifiedRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    ReclassifiedSequences = n_distinct(SequenceNorm),
    ExampleReferenceSets = paste(head(sort(unique(ReferenceSets)), 5), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl %>% mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample)), by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    CleanReads = replace_na(CleanReads, 0),
    ReclassifiedCleanFraction = if_else(CleanReads > 0, ReclassifiedReads / CleanReads, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample, desc(ReclassifiedReads), OriginalCategory)

write_csv_safe(endo_reclass_status, "07_reclassified_sports_sncRNA_distribution/01_status/endo_siRNA_reclassification_status.csv")
write_csv_safe(endo_reclass_evidence, "07_reclassified_sports_sncRNA_distribution/02_sequence_evidence/endo_siRNA_sample_sequence_evidence.csv")
write_csv_safe(reclassified_sports_length_by_sample, "07_reclassified_sports_sncRNA_distribution/03_length_distribution/endo_siRNA_reclassified_sports_length_by_sample.csv")
write_csv_safe(reclassified_sports_composition_by_sample, "07_reclassified_sports_sncRNA_distribution/04_composition/endo_siRNA_reclassified_sports_composition_by_sample.csv")
write_csv_safe(endo_replacement_audit, "07_reclassified_sports_sncRNA_distribution/05_replacement_audit/endo_siRNA_replacement_from_original_category.csv")

if (nrow(endo_reclass_evidence) == 0) {
  save_plot_nested(
    plot_note("endo-siRNA reclassified SPORTS distribution", "No endo-siRNA sample-sequence evidence was available; replacement is a no-op."),
    "07_reclassified_sports_sncRNA_distribution/01_status",
    "endo_siRNA_reclassified_sports_distribution_note.pdf",
    width = 8.5,
    height = 5,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

for (sample_id in as.character(sample_info$Sample)) {
  save_plot_nested(
    plot_reclassified_sports_length(sample_id, reclassified_sports_length_by_sample, reclassified_sports_levels, reclassified_sports_palette),
    "07_reclassified_sports_sncRNA_distribution/03_length_distribution",
    paste0("endo_siRNA_reclassified_sports_length_", sample_id, ".pdf"),
    sample = sample_id,
    width = 11,
    height = 6,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
  save_plot_nested(
    plot_reclassified_sports_composition(sample_id, reclassified_sports_composition_by_sample, reclassified_sports_levels, reclassified_sports_palette),
    "07_reclassified_sports_sncRNA_distribution/04_composition",
    paste0("endo_siRNA_reclassified_sports_composition_", sample_id, ".pdf"),
    sample = sample_id,
    width = 9.5,
    height = 5.8,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```

```{r interpretation-summary, include=FALSE}
interpretation_summary <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Output, ~Interpretation,
  "Exact-reference proxy", "Sequence-level overlap with selected local endo-siRNA references. This is conservative for known small RNA sequences but not coordinate evidence.",
  "Bowtie evidence", "Independent mapping of cutadapt-cleaned reads to local endo-siRNA references. Use the summary, length, reference-target, and sequence-candidate tables together.",
  "Dicer-sized fraction", "A high 21-24 nt fraction supports canonical oocyte endo-siRNA-like signal. A strong 26-31 nt fraction suggests piRNA-like overlap or reference ambiguity.",
  "Reclassified SPORTS distribution", "A display-only replacement view: sample-specific exact/Bowtie endo-siRNA sequence evidence is relabeled as endo-siRNA before rebuilding SPORTS-like sncRNA length and composition plots.",
  "Group shift", "Old/Young differences are descriptive unless replicate numbers and count depth support formal modelling; use p-values as screening evidence."
)
write_csv_safe(interpretation_summary, "06_interpretation/endo_siRNA_interpretation_summary.csv")
```
